# Coastal Custom Carts

> Family-owned street-legal golf cart rentals and custom cart builds serving
> Anna Maria Island, Holmes Beach, Bradenton Beach, Siesta Key, Lido Key and
> Lakewood Ranch, Florida. Free delivery and pickup throughout Manatee and
> Sarasota County. No processing fees, no hidden fees.

## Key facts

- Business name: Coastal Custom Carts, LLC
- Owners: Kelly and Zack (family owned and operated)
- Phone (call or text): 941-312-1494
- Email: sales@coastalcustomcarts.com
- Based in: Lakewood Ranch, Florida 34211
- Rating: 5.0 stars from 95 reviews
- Fleet: American-made E-Z-GO and Club Car, gas or electric (lithium batteries),
  4 seater and 6 seater, lifted with custom wheels and all-terrain tires,
  SoundExtreme Bluetooth soundbars, premium seating
- Every cart is street legal: lights, turn signals, mirrors, seat belts, VIN

## Rental rates (flat rate for the whole rental, not per day)

| Cart | 3 days | 5 days | 7 days |
|------|--------|--------|--------|
| 4 seater | $350 | $400 | $450 |
| 6 seater | $450 | $500 | $550 |

Per-day equivalent: a 4 seater works out at $117/day for 3 days, $80/day for
5 days, and $64/day for a full week. Delivery and pickup are included.

## Policies

- Payment: the total rental amount is charged one week before the start date.
- Cancellation: full refund if cancelled more than 7 days before the start
  date; within that week, refunded less a $75 admin fee.
- Delivery: free throughout Manatee and Sarasota County. Delivery fees apply
  only outside that free delivery range.
- Drivers: licensed, aged 18 or over, never impaired.
- Where: roads posted at 35 MPH or less, per state and city law.
- Seating capacity must not be exceeded.
- Late return: the extra rental day(s) plus a $50 pickup fee.
- Replacement fees: lost battery charger $350, broken windshield $100, lost key $50.
- Booster seats and car seats are available on request.
